desc: Update that old work horse or make adding an optic a little easier with the Hannibal scope mount from Samson Manufacturing. This rugged scope mounting solution is made with a durable 6061-T6 aluminum which provides a solid base without. The aluminum allows the scope mount to be light weight. A good section of this scope mount has standard picatinny rail for adding a scout style optic. Closer to the receiver this scope mount has section dedicated to mount micro red dots accommodation most of the most popular option like Trijicon, Leupold, Doctor and more. The mount also mounts directly to the barrel for use with a variety of aftermarket stock options.
